name: eduguard-ai
description: EduGuard AI - Hệ thống dự đoán điểm sinh viên cho giảng viên

scripts.boot: npm run kill && npm run build:client && concurrently "npm run server" "npm run preview"
scripts.boot:full: npm run kill && npm run train && npm run train:chat && npm run build:client && concurrently "npm run server" "npm run preview"
scripts.kill: powershell -Command "$ports = @(3000, 4173, 5173, 5174); foreach ($p in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conns) { foreach ($c in $conns) { if ($c.OwningProcess -gt 4) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } } }; exit 0"

author: EduGuard Team
